metadata.source: Congressional District Health Dashboard (NYU Langone Health), national Metric Map, Hex Map view
metadata.crs: Planar units from Leaflet CRS.Simple, x to the east, y to the north (y up). Not longitude/latitude.
metadata.grid: Pointy-top hex grid, spacing radius 12 (column step 20.785, row step 18). Hexes drawn at radius 11.5.
metadata.ids: geo_fips is the dashboard's ID (at-large = <state>01, DC = 1101). census_geoid_119 is the matching GEOID in Census cb_2024_us_cd119 files.
metadata.citation: Department of Population Health, NYU Langone Health. Congressional District Health Dashboard. www.congressionaldistricthealthdashboard.org. Accessed 2026-09-26.
